name: Cinder Crown
blurb: The smoking mountain at the end of the world, where the Coil keeps its oldest secrets.

currency.name: Orobuck
currency.tale: Cooled from the lava of the Cinder Crown and stamped while still glowing. Still warm years later; spend them before they burn a hole in your pocket.

merchant.name: Ember
merchant.line: One rune per trial. Every rune gives and every rune takes. Choose what you can live without.

challenger.name: The Ashen Oracle
challenger.line: Three trials, written in ash. The wind will erase them in a week.

banker.name: Ouro
banker.line: Every coin ever spent comes back to me eventually. I am very patient. I am a circle.

boss.name: Pyrrhus the Cinder Wyrm
boss.taunt: I have eaten islands. You are a light snack.

levels.name: Ashen Steps
levels.text: Embers on every step. Fire makes you fast. Reach 6,000.

levels.name: Bomb Quarry
levels.text: Bombs tick down and blow up a ring around them. Eat 22.

levels.name: The Lava Forge
levels.text: Spikes, fire and lava sludge. Survive 70 seconds.

levels.name: Obsidian Spiral
levels.text: Lightning flickers along the spiral. Grow to 32.

levels.name: Lair: The First Hunt
levels.text: Pyrrhus coils around the caldera. Survive him until he runs out of fire.

levels.name: Imp Warren
levels.text: Imps buzz and wraiths drift. Eat 24.

levels.name: Wyrmling Roost
levels.text: A wyrmling hunts your apples and your head. Reach 11,000.

levels.name: The Ember Vaults
levels.text: Five vault keys, one door, too many bombs.

levels.name: Smoke Choke
levels.text: The smoke is thick and the salamander is fast. Catch it five times.

levels.name: Lair: The Armored Duel
levels.text: Pyrrhus wears obsidian scales. Drain him and bite them off.

levels.name: Magma Run
levels.text: The magma rises behind you. Run 560 meters.

levels.name: Caldera Maze
levels.text: The Dragon's Eye glows somewhere in the caldera maze. Find it.

levels.name: Rune Lattice
levels.text: Seven runes in order across an endless lattice. The mountain is watching.

levels.name: Heart of the Mountain
levels.text: The mountain's heart beats walls up and down. Reach 14,000.

levels.name: Lair: The Last Stand
levels.text: The last fight. Tire the Cinder Wyrm and bite until the Crown is yours.
